name: Awaken Instruments
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 1, bard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./level)
Target up to 2 non-magical unattended instruments/level
Duration concentration
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You animate several non-magical unattended instruments within your range, and direct them to create music, ambient noise, or a cacophony of sound. Each instrument uses your relevant Perform skill.
